title: FrozenSubmission (neutral BenchBoard contract)
description: A frozen participant submission: copy plus verified source inventory, bound to one run manifest and rechecked before evaluation. The inventory holds allowed application source/config/tests and participant additions under the documented policy, excludes .git, dependencies, build caches, DSH runtime metadata and BenchBoard state, and rejects traversal, links/special files and case-colliding paths. The preserved tree digest algorithm — POSIX relative paths sorted lexically, pairs [path, sha256(bytes)], sha256 over the JSON pair list — is recomputed and compared, never trusted, by packages/core/manifest.mjs.

schemaVersion.$comment: Schema major is the discriminator; only major 1 is read and unknown majors are rejected, never coerced.

inventory.$comment: Each entry is exactly [posixPath, fileDigest]. Paths are participant-relative POSIX (no backslash, no colon, no ASCII control character U+0000-001F or DEL, relative, no absolute or nested form, no . or .. segments, no . or .. dot presentation in any segment, no trailing or empty segments) and sorted ascending with no duplicates; the runtime refuses everything else, and the same path contract is enforced by packages/core/identity.mjs hashEntries and by packages/core/manifest.mjs posixPathIssues (one exact path definition across identity, manifest/runtime and this schema).
